name: a diamond mark assembles into the closing wordmark
looks: A small coloured diamond shape settles alone on a light field, then the bold two-colour wordmark builds out beside it, a one-line tagline fades in beneath, and a small rounded start button settles last.
build: wordmark-assemble: the mark settles on a short spring first, then the name builds in from a tight cluster around it, the second colour applied only to part of the word; the tagline reveals on a clipPath wipe, the button arriving on back.out.
sound: A soft chime as the mark settles, quiet under the rest.
prompt: Close on a small geometric mark settling alone, then build the bold wordmark out beside it with two colours splitting the name. Fade in a short tagline beneath and settle a small rounded call-to-action button last, as the final frame.
